entities.name: Allowed SSC mode
entities.description: Information element included when the network rejects a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST with cause #68 'not supported SSC mode'.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to request establishment of a PDU session.

entities.name: Cause #68 - not supported SSC mode
entities.description: Condition where the network rejects the PDU session establishment due to unsupported SSC mode.

relations.description: The condition of cause #68 triggers the inclusion of the Allowed SSC mode IE in the rejection.
The PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message can be rejected with cause #68 when the SSC mode is not supported.
